物語

A Story of Food 物語

Before Kinoya had a counter, it had a dining table. It began as Chef Neha Mishra's home supper club, A Story of Food — sold out night after night, it welcomed more than 7,000 guests, and made her Dubai's “Ramen Queen”.

In 2021 the supper club became a restaurant at The Onyx Tower 2, The Greens. In 2023 it opened inside Harrods, London. The room stayed the same idea throughout: an izakaya's warmth, a ramen counter's focus.

  • 7,000+ guestswelcomed at the A Story of Food supper club
  • 2021Kinoya opens at The Onyx Tower 2, The Greens
